messages:
alice: Need quick signoff for a 2h, timeboxed SIEM export for vuln triage. Window: 2026-03-10T02:00:00Z -> 2026-03-10T04:00:00Z. Who can approve masked export?
ben: tagging. quick Q: will this include emails and full IPs?
alice: yes. Plan: user_id -> sha256(user_id + SALT), email -> "[redacted]", ip -> mask_last_octet (e.g. 10.2.3.0/24), drop oauth_token. Store SALT in vault, export encrypted to s3://redwood-ephemeral/<TKT-402>/, CMK alias/al_triage_TKT402, unwrap window 4h, retention delete after 7d.
claire: auditor must sign off and SALT must be vault-only (no PR secrets). Need infra PR to create resource-scoped role `triage_exporter/TKT-402` and bind permissions narrowly.
security-bot: checklist: 1) ticket created 2) SALT in vault 3) infra PR for temp role 4) KMS request 5) auditor approval 6) oncall assigned. Missing items block export.
dave-auditor: I can approve conditionally. Requirements: (a) SALT stored at vault://sec/TKT-402/salt, (b) KMS key must be HSM-origin or scoped CMK with limited Decrypt principals, (c) audit fields: grant_by, grant_reason, unwrap_by, unwrap_mfa, delete_time must be emitted.
alice: sample SIEM query: ```
auth.events
| where timestamp >= "2026-03-10T02:00:00Z" and timestamp <= "2026-03-10T04:00:00Z"
| where event in ("login_success", "login_failed")
```
curl example: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://siem.internal/api/v1/exports" -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"query":"<above>","scrub_rules":[{"field":"user_id","action":"sha256+salt","salt_ticket":"TKT-402"},{"field":"email","action":"redact"},{"field":"ip","action":"mask_last_octet"}],"destination":"s3://redwood-ephemeral/TKT-402/","kms_alias":"alias/al_triage_TKT402"}'
```
infra-ron: opening PR now to add role and lifecycle lambda: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/3344. PR scopes role to the single export prefix and tightens IAM. reviewers: @sre @seceng.
dave-auditor: KMS policy must restrict Decrypt to role ARN + oncall principal and require MFA for unwrap. Approving final export once KMS-2001 shows correct key_policy and SALT in vault.
oncall-eve: i'll be oncall that window. add me to unwrap principals and include exact commands I'll run for MFA unwrap.
security-bot: infra PR merged. KMS request filed KMS-2001. awaiting ops approval.
dave-auditor: KMS-2001 approved with HSM origin and Decrypt limited to triage role ARN + oncall-eve ARN. SALT verified at vault://sec/TKT-402/salt. approving export.
alice: kicking export job id=G-6602. pre-signed URL valid 4h from 2026-03-10T02:05:00Z.
oncall-eve: performed MFA unwrap and download, confirmed scrub rules took effect. auditlog entries present: grant=authz#G-6602, decrypt=crypto#G-6602, download=net#G-6602, delete scheduled.
dave-auditor: audit trail validated, SALT usage confirmed. closing approval.
alice: thanks all. follow-ups: add a reusable template for triage exports and a CI lint to catch broad SIEM permissions.
